text.text_excerpt: This is a little place tucked in off of Orleans Avenue in the French Quarter and was quite a nice find. We had small plates and several wine flights, which were nice to try several different wines that we would not otherwise have had. We had the house cheeseboard, crab cakes, bacon wrapped sea scallops, as well as beef medallions in a marsala sauce. All were quite delicious! it was nice to sit out in the courtyard, and the service was quite attentive

I stopped by here after a few days spent eating heavy yet oh so tasty Cajun food, I needed a break and wanted something a little lighter but still delicious.. the Orleans Grapevine hit the mark! First, the restaurant is really cute-small and romantic-but the patio is the real winner here. Cute little tables with twinkle lights, and each table had a heater underneath the umbrella-unless it's raining sit outside! The waitstaff was all wonderful, so helpful and really knowledgeable about the menu. The wine list was of course impressive, from high end to low end-tons of options for every taste. Now, let's get down to the food. The BBQ Shrimp. THE BBQ SHRIMP. That may have been the best thing ...

Came in for a late night bite and had a bunch of lovely small plates. The Brie was delicious as were the BBQ shrimp. The red wine flight was decent but I've had better ones at Whole Foods (of all places). It's right around the corner from Bourbon street but you wouldn't know it because it was quiet and low-key. Nice little patio out back would be great for when the weather is good.
